name: @planetaryescape/reader
description: Reading-surface building blocks shared by Marginalia and mxr: article renderer, text-range quote highlights, reader settings model, and plain-CSS themes and typography.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/reader.css dist/reader.css
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard dist)"
